utterances.speaker: host
utterances.text: Coming up, CES 2026 and the big shift from shiny gadgets to AI infrastructure and robots. Then, Pope Leo XIV meets Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado. And we’ll end with a nail-biter of a weekend for Georgetown women’s squash.

utterances.speaker: expert
utterances.text: It’s a mix of tech that’s moving into the physical world, diplomacy with real stakes, and sports where a few points can decide everything. Let’s get into it.
